  • Creative Testing: Collaborate with team members to plan, analyze, and implement test outcomes into new creative iterations.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Proven design experience, ideally within Amazon or eCommerce environments.
  • Proficiency in Figma (preferred) or Canva for rapid creative iteration.
  • Strong portfolio showcasing design work focused on performance or direct‑response results.
  • Excellent attention to visual detail, consistency, and brand cohesion.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work cross‑functionally.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with Amazon creative formats (main image, A+ content, carousel, Sponsored Brand, and Storefront).
  • Experience using polling and testing tools such as Intellivy or ProductPinion.
  • Understanding of eCommerce CRO principles (CTR, CVR, and visual hierarchy).
  • Basic familiarity with data‑driven creative testing and split testing.

What You’ll Gain

  • Opportunity to directly influence the performance of a fast‑growing Amazon brand.
  • Experience collaborating across design, analytics, and marketing teams.
  • A creative environment that values experimentation, data‑driven insights, and visual storytelling.

About Foundey

Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high‑quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early‑stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user‑centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast‑growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a highly experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast‑paced, startup environments.

The ideal candidate is a hands‑on product thinker with a deep understanding of user‑centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise‑grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.

Responsibilities

  • Lead end‑to‑end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high‑fidelity UI design.
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user‑centered design solutions.
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance.
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs.
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite.
  • Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design.
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.

Requirements

  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams.
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools.
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle.
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software.
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers.
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience as a Product Designer.
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.).
  • Background in designing data‑heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role‑based user permissions.
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers.
  • Prior experience working with U.S.-based startups or product teams.
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.

Why Join Us?

At Foundey, you will work on high‑impact projects for fast‑growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You'll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting‑edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

Vem fazer parte do Time IDG

Somos uma organização social privada sem fins lucrativos, especializada em gerir centros culturais públicos de grande importância para o país e programas ambientais. Atualmente, também prestamos consultorias para a concepção, modelagem, formatação e gestão de projetos, desenvolvendo o escopo, fazendo a captação de recursos, o enquadramento nas leis de incentivo e gerindo sua implementação.

O Paço do Frevo , localizado no coração do Recife, é mais do que um museu; é um guardião do patrimônio mundial da humanidade, celebrando a riqueza e a diversidade de nossa cultura.

O Museu do Amanhã , uma fascinante instituição de ciências no Rio de Janeiro, convida você a refletir sobre nossas ações presentes e seu impacto no amanhã, inspirando mudanças para um futuro melhor.

O Museu das Favelas em São Paulo é um espaço de resiliência e criatividade das comunidades, revelando a potência e o brilho das favelas através de suas histórias e expressões culturais únicas.

O Museu do Jardim Botânico do Rio de Janeiro é uma viagem encantadora pelo mundo da botânica, convidando você a explorar a beleza e a importância das plantas em nossas vidas.

O Programa de Formação Cultural CULTSP PRO - Escolas de Profissionais e de Empreendedores da Cultura, no Estado de São Paulo, oferece cursos em diversas áreas, incluindo Artes Cênicas, Audiovisual, Games, Moda, entre outras.

Sediado na cidade de Belém, o novo Museu das Amazônias , implementado pelo IDG em parceria com o Museu Paraense Emílio Goeldi, será uma referência na área de ciências e tecnologias. Com experiências imersivas e coletivas, irá reunir as muitas Amazônias, nacionais e internacionais, e aproximar os vários setores sociais para debater os temas da área.

Além dos museus, temos também a gestão do Fundo da Mata Atlântica e atuamos na revitalização do Cais do Valongo-RJ .

Nosso propósito é : Esperançar futuros possíveis

  • Criativos na essência: Acreditamos que a criatividade está no nosso DNA. Todos podemos praticá-la no dia a dia, seja na tarefa mais simples ou em projetos complexos;
  • Autenticamente diversos: Somos muitos, somos diferentes e cada vivência e visão de mundo importa. É da soma dessas diferenças que vêm as nossas melhores ideias;
  • Compromisso com excelência: Fazemos sempre o nosso melhor. Nos orgulhamos de estabelecer boas relações com nossos parceiros, colaboradores e todas as pessoas que estão na nossa rede, e de criar espaços encantadores de reflexão e conhecimento.
  • Respeito aos acordos: Entendemos que o respeito vai além da boa educação e deve ser a base no tratamento com qualquer um. Respeitamos os acordos e oferecemos segurança jurídica e financeira para construir laços de confiança.
  • Encantamento: Recebemos as pessoas com prazer e nos orgulhamos quando elas são maravilhadas pelos nossos espaços, seja no ambiente corporativo, seja nos museus. Incentivamos as pessoas a alcançarem o seu potencial e vivemos entusiasmados pelo nosso propósito.

Se você compartilha da nossa paixão por promover o acesso à cultura, preservar o meio ambiente e inspirar mudanças positivas, junte-se a nós! Estamos sempre em busca de mentes criativas e comprometidas para se juntar à nossa equipe e fazer a diferença.

Venha fazer parte dessa jornada conosco!

Join to apply for the Regional Sales Manager role at Autronica Fire and Security AS

At Autronica, you’re joining a leading innovator, supplier, and system integrator of fire and gas safety solutions worldwide. Our products protect lives and assets on land, at sea, and in the energy sectors. We are an international company with offices across the globe, and our HQ is located in Trondheim, Norway’s technology hotspot. Autronica’s greatest assets are the expertise, creativity, and passion of our employees – and we’re excited for you to join the team.

Do you want to be part of a highly committed team striving toward our vision of zero loss of lives, no injuries, or damages caused by fire and gas?

About the role

Autronica is seeking a Regional Sales Manager for the Energy sector to grow the company’s Fire and Security solutions across South America. In this role you will engage directly with clients, EPCs, system integrators, MEP, and other industrial land contractors, driving project wins and expanding Autronica’s presence in the region. The role covers FPSO, LNG, Clean Energy, and conventional energy projects across upstream, midstream, and downstream segments, as well as emerging markets such as Renewables.

Reporting to the Regional Sales Director, you will work to ensure alignment, sustainable growth, market leadership and ensure Autronica’s solutions continue to protect assets, people, and operations across the energy sector.

Preferred locations for the role are Rio de Janeiro or Sao Paulo, Brazil.

Responsibilities

Your responsibilities as a Regional Sales Manager will be:

Business Growth & Market Leadership

  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities with end users, EPCs, system integrators, MEP, and industrial contractors as well as explore new applications for our solutions in emerging energy markets.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships to expand market penetration and reinforce Autronica’s reputation.
  • Deliver accurate forecasts, maintain strong margins, and propose comprehensive fire and gas detection solutions.
  • Partner with global teams and across functions to engage EPCs, MEPs, engineering firms, and stakeholders and to leverage best practices and market intelligence.
  • Act as a trusted advisor and build alliances with third-party partners to strengthen market growth.
  • Develop partnerships with end-users, distributors, and industry influencers and ensure Autronica’s inclusion on Approved Vendor Lists (AVLs) and organize events with distributors.
  • Lead preparation of major bids, ensure compliance with pricing and approvals, and maximize profitability.

Compliance & Values

  • Ensure adherence to Autronica’s ethics, EHS requirements, and company policies.
  • Support continuous improvement across the region.

Who we are looking for

To be successful in this role, you’ll bring a proactive, results-driven approach and a strong commercial mindset. You combine strategic vision with hands‑on engagement, enjoy building lasting relationships with clients and partners, and thrive in dynamic, multicultural environments where you can make a real impact. You approach challenges with a problem-solving mindset, communicate with clarity and influence, and stay focused and adaptable while managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced, evolving market.

Qualifications and experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related field (Electronics, Electrical, Automation, Controls or relevant).
  • Diversified sales experience in technology-driven industries.
  • Solid experience in selling safety, automation, or related solutions to EPCs, MEP/contractors, system integrators, or end customers in the energy sector.
  • Established regional network and extensive regional market knowledge.
  • Proven experience in instrumentation sales within the oil & gas sector, combined with a strong track record in pursuing and winning EPC (Engineering, Procurement & Construction) projects.
  • Proficient in Salesforce or similar CRM tools for managing pipelines, forecasting, and reporting.

What we offer

  • An exciting and challenging position in a team with skilled colleagues.
  • Competitive conditions and flexible working time arrangements.
  • A professional work environment where we always strive to deliver and exceed expectations.

Our commitment to you

As an employer of choice, our greatest assets are the expertise, creativity, and passion of our employees. We strive to provide a great place to work that attracts, develops, and retains the best talent, promotes employee engagement, fosters teamwork, and drives innovation for the benefit of our customers. We aim to create an environment where you feel that you belong, with diversity and inclusion as the engine to growth and innovation. We develop and deploy best-in-class programs and practices, providing enriching career opportunities, listening to employee feedback, and always challenging ourselves to do better.

The values that guide us are respect, integrity, inclusion, innovation, and excellence.

We’re excited for you to join us and make a difference.

Sobre a CBO

Somos a segunda maior empresa, em número de embarcações, do Brasil, no segmento offshore, com mais de 40 anos de tradição, inovação e pioneirismo.

Nossos principais valores são segurança, sustentabilidade, integridade, atendimento, resultado, inovação e gente. Valorizamos a diversidade e a inclusão, e buscamos criar um ambiente cada vez mais diverso e seguro para todas e todos. Temos como estratégia a contratação de pessoas com deficiência e outros públicos diversos, como mulheres, negros, e o público LGBTQIA+.

Descrição da Resumida

Nesse papel, você será responsável por apoiar a operação marítima garantindo que as equipes embarcadas tenham condições seguras de trabalho, atuando em toda a cadeia de prevenção, controle e resposta a emergências.

Principais Atividades

  • Atuar como Responsável Técnica (RT) da companhia, representando a empresa junto ao CRN, Anvisa e demais órgãos reguladores.
  • Elaborar e atualizar manuais, POPs, fluxos, procedimentos e políticas de segurança alimentar e sanitária para toda a frota.
  • Realizar auditorias sanitárias internas a bordo das embarcações, registrando evidências, não conformidades e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Acompanhar auditorias sanitárias de clientes e autoridades , garantindo conformidade e suporte técnico.
  • Desenvolver e conduzir treinamentos e capacitações (onshore e offshore) sobre Boas Práticas, higiene, manipulação de alimentos e padrões sanitários.
  • Participar da implementação do projeto “Bordo Digital” , transformando checklists, formulários e registros técnicos em processos digitais.
  • Realizar análise e tratamento de não conformidades , incluindo elaboração de relatórios, definição de planos de ação e acompanhamento das tratativas.
  • Monitorar indicadores de segurança sanitária (KPIs) , avaliando desempenho, tendências e necessidades de ajuste.
  • Acompanhar e supervisionar a consultoria especializada, garantindo execução de cronogramas, inspeções e manuais de higienização.
  • Apoiar a operação e as equipes de bordo na implementação e manutenção dos padrões sanitários exigidos por normas, clientes e legislação .
  • Contribuir para a cultura de Qualidade, Segurança, Saúde e Meio Ambiente , fortalecendo práticas operacionais seguras e conformes.

Requisitos

  • Graduação em Nutrição com CRN ativo ;
  • Experiência em segurança alimentar , Boas Práticas de Manipulação e inspeções sanitárias;
  • Vivência com auditorias internas e externas , elaboração de POPs, manuais e procedimentos sanitários;
  • Capacidade de conduzir treinamentos técnicos e orientar equipes operacionais;
  • Disponibilidade para visitas periódicas às embarcações e acompanhamento das rotinas de bordo;
  • Experiência com análise e tratativas de não conformidades , elaboração de relatórios e planos de ação.

Diferenciais

  • Atuação com operações marítimas/offshore , hotelaria marítima ou estaleiros;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas digitais, gestão de indicadores (KPIs) e transformação digital de processos;
  • Experiência com gestão de fornecedores e controle sanitário de rancho;
  • Participação em auditorias sanitárias.
  • Carteira de Motorista (CNH B)

O que oferecemos para você

  • Day off de aniversário

THE POSITION

The Coordinator of Government Relations and Host City Management provides administrative, organizational, and operational support to the Manager and Head of the area, ensuring structure, information organization, and adequate preparation for institutional interactions with public authorities and government partners at the federal, state, and municipal levels.

As the focal point for organization and follow‑up, this professional supports the transformation of strategic demands into structured materials, organized agendas, and systematic follow‑up, helping the area's leadership to focus its efforts on institutional coordination, decision‑making, and diplomatic relations.

    • Preparation of materials: Prepare initial drafts, structure content, and format presentations, progress reports, tables, and executive summaries, under the guidance of Management.

    • Minutes and follow‑up: Write meeting minutes in a clear and objective manner and follow up on the implementation of agreed actions, reporting on progress and pending issues.
  3. Operational Liaison and Strategy Support
    • Operational point of contact: Act as the first point of contact with technical and administrative teams from ministries, secretariats, and city halls for operational issues and routine information exchanges.
    • Strategy support: Collect, organize, and systematize data and information to support technical notes, analyses, and institutional positions prepared by Management.
    • Contract monitoring: Update reports, spreadsheets, and instruments for monitoring the commitments set forth in the Host City Contracts, signaling risks, gaps, and critical deadlines.

YOUR PROFILE

Behavioral Competencies

  • Attention to detail: Rigorous with quality, consistency of information, and meeting deadlines.
  • Institutional communication: Clear oral and written communication, with tone and language appropriate to the institutional environment.

Differential

Requirements

title: Workday Integrations Developer - Brazil
description:
VirtualResource (VR) is a boutique consultancy supporting companies to optimise their HR systems and Workday.

We strive to be the go-to company that partners with businesses to optimise their HR technology landscape.

What is the role about?

We are looking for an experienced Workday Integrations Developer with a strong Payroll integration experience (can be either integration with Workday Payroll or 3rd party Payroll systems), who is based in the Latin America time zone.

As a Workday Integrations Developer, you will design, build, and maintain integrations between Workday and Payroll systems, ensuring seamless data flow and accuracy. This role involves working closely with clients to understand requirements, troubleshoot issues, and optimise integration solutions to meet business needs. Your expertise will help clients maximise the efficiency of their Payroll operations through robust Workday integrations.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and deploy Workday integrations for Payroll systems (Workday Payroll or third‑party systems).
  • Collaborate with clients to gather requirements and provide tailored integration solutions.
  • Utilise tools such as Workday Studio, EIBs, Core Connectors, and APIs to build and maintain integrations.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve integration issues to ensure data accuracy and seamless functionality.
  • Conduct testing and validation of integrations, including error handling and edge cases.
  • Document integration processes, field mappings, and system workflows for future reference.
  • Work closely with cross‑functional teams, including HR, IT, and external vendors, to support Payroll operations.
  • Ensure compliance with data privacy, security, and organisational policies in all integration work.
  • Optimise and enhance existing integrations to improve performance and scalability.

What skills are we looking for?

Our roles are remotely based (even pre‑Covid), meaning you will be working from your home office, connecting with your client and team on a daily basis.

To be successful in this type of environment, you will need to have the ability to communicate effectively (in English) with cross‑functional teams, explain complex concepts in easy, understandable terms, align HR / business knowledge with Workday functionality, and proactively drive process improvements. You will need to be comfortable with video calls and be proactive in keeping communication channels open with your client and team.

Skills and Experience Required

  • 3 - 5 years’ Workday Integration and implementation experience including payroll integrations (either Workday Payroll and/or 3rd party payroll systems);
  • 5+ years of experience in the application of modern integration technologies (EDI, Web Services, XML, XSLT, Java, .Net, middleware).
  • Attention to detail and the ability to see the big picture, pragmatic problem solver.
  • Excellent planning, interpersonal and time management skills with a track record of following through on dedications.
  • Excellent technical communication skills are essential.
  • Fluent in English (writing, reading, and speaking).
  • Fluent in Portuguese (writing, reading, and speaking).
  • Ability to work independently and cross‑functionally.

Other Qualifications/Skills that will be beneficial but not mandatory

  • College or University Degree in HR or Information Systems.
  • Experience with any of the following: Java, JavaScript, .NET, XSLT, NetBeans IDE development background.
  • Experience in other critical corporate platform implementations such as Workday, Oracle, PeopleSoft, Sailpoint, SAP, Siebel, MuleSoft, Dellboomi, or applications built on AWS services.

As this is a remote role, you can be based anywhere in the Latin America region so long as you are authorised to work without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.

description:

About Agoda
At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world. Today, we are part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide. No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know our Team:
The Performance Marketing Team of Agoda is a world leader in online marketing. This department is highly data-driven and focused on developing at-scale marketing programs that improve the lifetime value of Agoda customers through measurable marketing programs and channels. The team is a blend of the best analysts, marketing strategists, and data scientists in the world. The marketing leadership at Agoda have deep experience in data science, product, strategy, and other marketing fields and have built an organization that thrives on data, creative ideas, and technology. The Performance Marketing Team also fosters a great learning environment. You will be able to learn and grow by working closely with experts from a variety of backgrounds from all over the world.

In this role, you’ll get to:

  • Set Marketing strategy for Flights verticals (outside of pricing)
  • Spearhead the development, execution, and optimization strategy for growing Agoda’s Flights business on different channels
  • Conduct end-to-end analysis of large, complex datasets related to channel performance, user behavior, and market trends, translating raw data into actionable insights
  • Develop hypotheses, design experiments (e.g., A/B tests), and build structured analyses to rigorously evaluate campaign effectiveness and drive data-driven decisions for channel growth
  • Partner closely with various business functions, especially Marketing Accommodation, Flights product and flights supply, to identify opportunities, analyze, and interpret trends or patterns in complex data sets using different techniques and tools such as SQL or Tableau
  • Communicate complex findings, performance updates, and strategic recommendations clearly and concisely to key stakeholders, including senior management

What you’ll need to succeed:

  • Extensive Experience: 5-7 years in Data Analyst position or otherwise in projects involving big data — preferably in the tech, e-commerce, or digital marketing industry. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science/Statistics/Math or Engineering or Economics and Finance is a plus.
  • Data-Driven Approach: Strong analytical skills with the ability to analyze data, translate data into actionable insights, and generate impactful recommendations. Proficient in business intelligence tools and data warehouse i.e. SQL, Tableau and MS Excel.
  • Innovative Problem-Solving Skills: The ability to tackle complex challenges in a non-linear fashion is essential. We seek a resourceful candidate who can effectively navigate the organization to gather necessary information and implement innovative solutions while adapting to evolving scenarios and leveraging valuable resources creatively.
  • Strong Communication Skills: Exceptional writing and verbal communication abilities, with proficiency in creating impactful and visually appealing presentations.
  • Stakeholder management: Ability to effectively communicate, influence and persuade with different levels of stakeholders (including Senior Management) with proven strong commercial acumen.

It’s great if you have:

  • Experience in digital or social media marketing
  • Experience in hypothesis testing frameworks, statistical analysis, and using Python/R for data manipulation and analysis.

At Mindrift, innovation meets opportunity. We believe in using the power of collective human intelligence to ethically shape the future of AI.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with AI projects from major tech innovators. Our mission is to unlock the potential of Generative AI by tapping into real-world expertise from across the globe.

About The Role

We're looking for someone who can design realistic and structured evaluation scenarios for LLM-based agents. You'll create test cases that simulate human‑performed tasks and define gold‑standard behavior to compare agent actions against. You'll work to ensure each scenario is clearly defined, well‑scored, and easy to execute and reuse. You'll need a sharp analytical mindset, attention to detail, and an interest in how AI agents make decisions.

Typical Responsibilities

  • Create structured test cases that simulate complex human workflows.
  • Define gold‑standard behavior and scoring logic to evaluate agent actions.
  • Analyze agent logs, failure modes, and decision paths.
  • Work with code repositories and test frameworks to validate your scenarios.
  • Iterate on prompts, instructions, and test cases to improve clarity and difficulty.
  • Ensure that scenarios are production‑ready, easy to run, and reusable.

How To Get Started

Simply apply to this post, qualify, and get the chance to contribute to projects aligned with your skills, on your own schedule. From creating training prompts to refining model responses, you'll help shape the future of AI while ensuring technology benefits everyone.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's and/or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science / Data Analytics, Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning, Computational Linguistics / Natural Language Processing (NLP), Information Systems or other related fields.
  • Background in QA, software testing, data analysis, or NLP annotation.
  • Good understanding of test design principles (e.g., reproducibility, coverage, edge cases).
  • Strong written communication skills in English.
  • Comfortable with structured formats like JSON/YAML for scenario description.
  • Can define expected agent behaviors (gold paths) and scoring logic.
  • Basic experience with Python and JS.
  • Curious and open to working with AI-generated content, agent logs, and prompt-based behavior.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in writing manual or automated test cases.
  • Familiarity with LLM capabilities and typical failure modes.
  • Understanding of scoring metrics (precision, recall, coverage, reward functions).

Benefits

  • Get paid for your expertise, with rates that can go up to $17/hour depending on your skills, experience, and project needs.
  • Take part in a flexible, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments.
  • Participate in an advanced AI project and gain valuable experience to enhance your portfolio.
  • Influence how future AI models understand and communicate in your field of expertise.

Overview

Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early‑stage SaaS startups in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user‑centric digital experiences.

Opportunity

We are looking for a highly experienced and strategic Product Designer.

This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast‑paced, startup environments.

The ideal candidate is a hands‑on product thinker with a deep understanding of user‑centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise‑grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.

Responsibilities

  • Lead end‑to‑end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high‑fidelity UI design.
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user‑centered design solutions.
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance.
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs.
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite.
  • Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design.
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.

Requirements

  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written).
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools.
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle.
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software.
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers.
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience as a Product Designer.
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms).
  • Background in designing data‑heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role‑based user permissions.
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers.
  • Prior experience working with US‑based startups or product teams.
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.

Why Join Us

At Foundey, you will work on high‑impact projects for fast‑growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide.

You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting‑edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

How to Apply

title: Engenheiro(a) Subsea Pleno
description:
Subsea Operations Support Service - Scope of Work

Service Overview

This service provides comprehensive support for subsea equipment installation, intervention, and vessel operations, ensuring safe, efficient, and compliant execution in alignment with Client standards and offshore asset requirements.

Key Service Deliverables

  • Subsea Execution Management – Lead and supervise the installation and intervention of subsea equipment, ensuring all operational procedures and equipment scopes are thoroughly reviewed, approved, and ready prior to execution.
  • Daily Vessel Operations Oversight – Oversee daily vessel activities, providing full subsea support to Client-operated FPSOs and offshore assets, including SIMOPS coordination and activity planning.
  • SIMOPS Coordination – Conduct daily SIMOPS calls to identify and mitigate potential conflicts between vessel and FPSO operations, ensuring seamless integration of activities.
  • Performance Monitoring & Optimization – Monitor vessel performance metrics, identify operational inefficiencies, and implement improvement strategies to enhance service delivery.
  • Contingency Management – Manage and resolve issues outlined in operational contingency plans, ensuring continuity and safety of field operations.
  • Port Call Planning – Define and manage the scope, schedule, and duration of port calls, ensuring alignment with operational requirements and minimizing downtime.
  • HSSE Leadership Onboard – Promote onboard wellbeing through continuous engagement with vessel leadership (ROV Superintendent and Vessel Captain). Support third‑party personnel working for the Client, ensuring all necessary resources are available for task completion.
  • QA/QC Oversight – Ensure quality assurance and control of operational equipment, including ROVs, cranes, rigging gear, spares, and inventory.
  • Weather & Scheduling Coordination – Assess weather forecasts and coordinate field operation schedules across offshore assets.
  • Technical Engagement – Participate in planning meetings and technical discussions related to vessel operations and IMR campaigns.
  • Material Management – Maintain onboard inventory of Client equipment and coordinate logistics for loadouts and backloads, ensuring equipment availability and readiness.
  • Operational Documentation – Ensure completion and submission of required documentation after each subsea activity, maintaining records in Client’s designated systems.
  • Equipment Readiness & Testing – Conduct basic equipment inspections, testing, and minor assemblies to ensure operational readiness and safety prior to use.

About Us: A Wood is a global leader in consulting and engineering, helping to find solutions to critical challenges in the energy and materials markets. We provide consulting, project, and operational solutions in 60 countries, employing around 35,000 people.

Declaração de Diversidade – Somos uma empresa que oferece igualdade de oportunidades e reconhece o valor de uma força de trabalho diversificada. Todos os candidatos devidamente qualificados serão considerados para a vaga com base em critérios objetivos e sem levar em conta os seguintes fatores (lista não exaustiva): raça, cor, idade, religião, sexo, nacionalidade, deficiência, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, estatuto de veterano protegido ou outras características, de acordo com as leis aplicáveis.

description:
Job description

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Main responsibilities

Executar atividades de nutrição revisando os cardápios e dietas dos pacientes, bem como adequando o teor nutricional dos alimentos a fim de assegurar o atendimento das prescrições médicas.

Requirements and skills

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Nutrição
  • Especialização completa em uma ou mais das áreas citadas a seguir: Nutrição em Pediatria, Nutrição em Materno Infantil, Nutrição Clínica, Nutrição Geriatria e Gerontologia, Nutrição em Fitoterapia Nutricional ou Residência Multiprofissional em Saúde
  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe
  • Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada na função de Nutricionista.

Fundado por portugueses nos anos 50 com o nome “Casas Guanabara”, o pequeno comércio se transformou no Supermercados Guanabara, uma das mais tradicionais e modernas redes do país. Atualmente possui 28 lojas distribuídas no Rio, Grande Rio, Baixada Fluminense e Região Metropolitana, dois centros de distribuição e dois depósitos.

Paragarantir a melhor experiência de compras para os seus clientes, prezando pelo conforto e segurança, as unidades contam com piso antiderrapante, rampas de acesso para facilitar a circulação, corredores amplos, grande quantidade de check‑outs, estacionamento inteligente, além de um mix diferenciado para atender a qualquer orçamento.

A rede de Supermercados Guanabara segue atendência mundial do setor supermercadista, implantou uma loja a captação da água da chuva e do sistema de ar-condicionado, com reúso nos banheiros e lavagem das lojas. Você sabia que a rede inovou e levou o shopping para dentro do supermercado? Atualmente, várias unidades Guanabara possuem centro comercial com lojas de serviço e grandes magazines. Algumas lojas operam com sistema store-in-store, orientação desommelierna hora da escolha de vinhos.

O Guanabara também inovou no calendário varejista do estado do Rio de Janeiro e criou campanhas promocionais como: Semana da Beleza, Semana da Limpeza, Guanababy, Black Fraldas e o tradicional Aniversário Guanabara!

A rede já foi eleita pela revista Veja Rio como A marca mais amada do Rio e por 14 anos pela pesquisa “Marcas dos Cariocas”, em parceria com O Globo, a Marca preferida dos Cariocas .

description:
Company Overview

Acreditamos na tecnologia que conecta gente boa no que faz e que vive a diversidade para criar e compartilhar até os caminhos que a gente (ainda!) nem sabe quais são. Trabalhamos para gerar valor não só para os nossos usuários, mas, sobretudo, para as comunidades que servimos e toda a sociedade, tornando a vida das pessoas melhor com serviços que facilitem seu dia a dia - seja com serviços de mobilidade e entrega (99) ou pagamentos digitais (99Pay).

Para facilitar a vida de milhões de pessoas todos os dias, desde 2018 fazemos parte da DiDi Global Inc., a maior plataforma de tecnologia e transporte por aplicativo do mundo. Somos pioneiros na criação de soluções inovadoras que começam no Brasil e que ganham escala para gerar impacto positivo em mais de 12 países em que a DiDi está presente. Essas inovações passam por sustentabilidade, segurança, inteligência artificial, mercado financeiro e um tanto mais.

description:
ENGENHEIRO PRINCIPAL DE SEGURANÇA DE PROCESSOS / Process Safety Principal Engineer

Responsible for being Technical Reference and Local Legal Responsible, within the Process Safety discipline, focusing on long‑term strategies, governance, technical guidelines, projects, and action plans, which includes the evaluation and identification of improvements in business value, compliance, and technical safety, in order to ensure fleet performance improvement by considering best practices in all MODEC Group shared as common practices, as well as promoting research and development.

Responsibilities and assignments

We are looking for a Process Safety Principal Engineer to work in our Base in RIO DE JANEIRO, RJ developing activities such as:

  • Guarantee the continuous improvement of IMS by monitoring project status and ensuring that IMS documents under the Process Safety discipline are updated and implemented.
  • Support MdB's corporate annual budget planning (expenses and investments) by participating and guiding the team about the corporate planning, providing information about workforce planning for the Process Safety discipline and about resources, services and materials needs and other expenses used in its activities.
  • Contribute to MODEC participation in BIDs, by supporting the preparation/development of new projects together with the MOPS/MII/MINC/Pre‑Ops team, by bringing technical and operational experience to the new projects in development, assuring technical excellence in all deliverables.
  • Ensure knowledge management, which includes monitoring its starts, actions taken, knowledge database maintenance, as well as auditing the inclusion of the forms in the system, by sharing lessons learned among the MODEC Operations Fleet and Sister companies, and by being responsible for extracting, listing up, reviewing, and verifying all lessons learned from operations experience.
  • Ensure technical support to, for a specific case to be defined by proper procedure (boundary scope), by acting as Technical Reference to assist in the response of MOCs, TQs, RCAs, CAPA, NOI and safety studies recommendations.
  • Contribute to develop and maintain Global Design Philosophy & Functional Specifications, by reviewing and/or updating each assigned document.
  • Develop and improve all the technical/business lifecycle guide/process/procedures from BID, EPCI, Pre‑Ops, operation, maintenance, and decommissioning, by actively participating on all phases of Projects, constantly monitoring, and analyzing all standards and guidelines defined for Process coordination, as well as proposing and elaborating action plans for the Technical Recommendations received from other Tiers.
  • Maximize business lifecycle value and ensure fleet performance improvement, by developing and researching new technologies, proposing KPIs, providing technical guidance on issues related to the Process Safety discipline, and on action plans of continuous improvement.
  • Analyze and guide the development of strategic documents related to the Process Safety discipline such as philosophies, guidelines, and technical notes in order to maintain fleet compliance to regulations, industry standards and global MODEC policies, and to enhance Offshore Units operations based on lessons learned applicable to the MdB fleet.
  • Contribute to fleet improvement changes by guiding and validating the development of engineering basic design and estimating man‑hour for high‑risk modification projects related to the Process Safety disciplines, guaranteeing that the modification will attend MODEC/International standards and Classified Society.
  • Support internal, external, and regulatory audits, by providing engineering technical expertise on the Process Safety discipline.

Requirements and qualifications

  • Valid CREA registration is mandatory.
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience.
  • Previous experience in Offshore/Onshore Oil & Gas area is expected, as well as experience with ANP.
  • Prior experience in FPSOs is expected.
  • Postgraduate studies in areas related to the discipline of expertise are expected.
  • MBA or equivalent is a plus.
  • Advanced English is mandatory. Fluency is a plus.
  • Experience with CMMS software (e.g., SAP) is expected.
  • Basic Hazard Analysis Software knowledge is a competitive edge (PHA Pro Tool preferred).
  • Basic Visual Risk Assessment Software knowledge is a competitive edge (Bowtie XP preferred).
  • Basic Consequence Modelling Software is a competitive edge (e.g., DNV PHAST).

Additional information

Being part of Modec means being the PROTAGONIST of a CHALLENGING career and being in touch with the latest deep‑water production systems, knowing that your career begins in BRAZIL, but your talent can take you anywhere in the WORLD.

If you want to be one of the greatest in the market, this is your opportunity!!

As a MULTICULTURAL company that respects DIVERSITY, we encourage PWD application in our process.

  • Step 3: Fit Cultural 3 Fit Cultural
  • Step 8: Hiring 8 Hiring

Career without borders

At MODEC, our greatest asset is our people. With more than 55 years of history and two decades operating in Brazil, we are a global company in constant growth, present on five continents and a reference in the construction, chartering, and operation of offshore platforms.

In Brazil, we operate 14 production units and have two under construction, bringing together more than 3,300 professionals who build, every day, a safer, more sustainable, and more innovative future.

Here, we value diversity, inclusion, and continuous development. Our environment is collaborative and multicultural, guided by a purpose: to unite people and technologies to transform energy into opportunities.

The Principal ROV Specialist interprets internal or external business issues and recommends best practices. As such, they must have in-depth expertise in ROV (Mar) as well as broad knowledge of the ROV (Mar) discipline within the Marine function.

  • Degree in Engineering
  • Minimum 10 years in offshore remote subsea system design and operations
  • Min. 8 years of experience supporting construction projects
  • Good command of English both oral and written
  • Proficient in the use of subsea ROV & ROV tooling systems
  • Previous offshore experience
  • Proven experience working with ROVs and tooling packs
  • Willingness to travel
  • Extensive knowledge/expertise in Subsea Remote Systems design, functioning, and operation (ROV, ROV Tooling, subsea architecture, connectors, flying leads…)
  • Extensive knowledge/expertise in the design, functioning, and operation of remote subsea tooling associated with ROV and subsea hardware operation

  • Good understanding of QHSE

  • Oversee Commissioning Tooling Requirements
  • Carry out ROV access studies and checks
  • Desktop studies
  • Ensure efficient and excellent integration of the subsea interfaces of SURF project to the marine operations execution

Deliverables

  • Ensure ROV contractors comply with statutory and IMCA guidelines

  • Liaison with Clients / ROV contractors both on and offshore to confirm operational status

  • Ensure that the EPC Contractor meets the technical quality and timely delivery of their deliverables
  • Provide technical / construction support as part of the subsea team in dealing with key vendors
  • Participate in Installation Constructability Reviews and HAZID’s
  • Ensure that the offshore execution is performed safely, timely, and as efficiently as possible, providing quality reporting throughout the offshore period

Reports to

  • Functional: Director ROV Operations
  • Regional: MAO And Senior Manager Marine Operations
  • Project/Construction Manager when assigned to the project
  • Supervises: Ops Engineers/Field Engineers/Draftspersons
  • Liaise with: All Marine operations personnel, functional managers, Engineering design teams, project engineering, tendering teams, procurement/subcontract coordinators, and clients

Seus desafios serão:

  • Definir a arquitetura de soluções de IA, incluindo frameworks, modelos, pipelines e tecnologias recomendadas.

  • Traduzir desafios de negócio em problemas científicos claros e solucionáveis com IA.
  • Conduzir experimentação, criação de protótipos e avaliações técnicas de modelos.

  • Avaliar novas tecnologias, papers, arquiteturas e abordagens do mercado, propondo melhorias contínuas.
  • Atuar como referência técnica do time, orientando decisões e garantindo qualidade das entregas.

O que é necessário você ter:

  • Ensino superior completo em áreas de TI.

  • Conhecimento em modelos LLMs (open‑source e proprietários), RAG, embeddings e ferramentas avançadas de IA generativa.
  • Experiência com Python e frameworks como TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit‑Learn, HuggingFace, LangChain ou equivalentes.
  • Entendimento de boas práticas de engenharia (versionamento, testes, pipelines, CI/CD).

  • Conhecimento de arquiteturas modernas para agentes inteligentes e automação baseada em IA.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com otimização de modelos (quantização, LoRA, fine‑tuning).

Estamos presentes em 31 municípios, levando energia para mais de 4 milhões de clientes e conectando mais de 11 milhões de vidas com qualidade, confiabilidade e propósito.

O que nos move vai além da eletricidade: é a vontade de fazer diferente, de criar soluções sustentáveis, de colocar o cliente no centro e de transformar realidades, sempre com ética, simplicidade, inteligência de dados e, acima de tudo, com gente boa.

Nosso compromisso é contribuir para o bem‑estar da sociedade e liderar a transformação do setor elétrico com responsabilidade, inovação e eficiência.

Aqui, você encontra um ambiente que valoriza novas ideias. Onde resultados são reconhecidos, os desafios são grandes e o aprendizado é ainda maior. Acreditamos em pessoas inquietas, que pensam como donas, que buscam sempre o melhor e têm coragem para inovar em um setor em plena evolução.

Formação:

  • Superior Completo em Engenharia Química ou Engenharia de Petróleo/Mecânica.

Responsabilidades:

I. Liderança Técnica e Validação de Deliverables

  • Revisão Crítica de Documentação: Liderar a revisão e aprovação de documentos chaves da Engenharia de Processos para o detalhamento, incluindo:
    • Diagramas de Fluxo de Processo (PFDs) e Diagramas de Tubulação e Instrumentação (P&IDs).
    • Folhas de Dados (Datasheets) de Equipamentos Estáticos e Rotativos, Válvulas de Controle e Alívio (PSV/PRV).
    • Análises de Alívio e Despressurização de Sistemas (Blowdown/Flare System Design).
    • Especificações de Sistemas Químicos e Utilidades (ex: Gás Combustível, Água de Resfriamento).
  • Otimização e Design Review: Participar ativamente em reuniões de HAZOP, SIL/LOPA e Design Reviews para identificar e mitigar riscos operacionais e de segurança.
  • Cálculos de Processo: Realizar e/ou auditar cálculos complexos, como balanços de massa e energia, dimensionamento de linhas, sizing de vasos e trocadores de calor, e simulações termodinâmicas.
  • Gestão de Mudanças: Gerenciar e documentar alterações de escopo (Management of Change - MOC) relacionadas a processos durante a fase de detalhamento.

II. Colaboração e Interface

  • Interface Multidisciplinar: Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as equipes de Engenharia de Tubulação, Instrumentação, Elétrica e Civil para garantir que o layout e a interconexão dos sistemas de processo sejam viáveis, seguros e eficientes.
  • Suporte a Suprimentos: Prestar suporte técnico à equipe de Suprimentos na avaliação técnica de propostas de fornecedores de equipamentos críticos.
  • Interação com Clientes/Órgãos Reguladores: Apresentar e defender soluções técnicas de processo para o cliente e/ou agências reguladoras (se necessário).

III. Normas e Qualidade

  • Conformidade Normativa: Assegurar que todos os projetos de processo cumpram rigorosamente as normas Nacionais e Internacionais aplicáveis à indústria de O&G (Ex: API RP, ASME B31.3, NRs, DNV/ABS).
  • Padronização: Promover a padronização de metodologias e documentação para aumentar a eficiência e a qualidade nos deliverables de Processo.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência em Processos e/ou como Engenheiro(a) de Processos, atuando diretamente em projetos de Engenharia de Detalhamento para unidade de óleo e Gás (Ex: FPSOs, Refinarias, Terminals ou Plantas Petroquímicas).
  • Domínio na interpretação e geração de P&IDs e PFDs.
  • Conhecimento sólido em sistemas de segurança de processo (PSV sizing, Flare/Blowdown).
  • Proficiência em softwares de simulação de processo (Ex: HYSYS, ASPEN Plus ou PRO/II).
  • Fluência em inglês.
  • Abordagem metódica e zero tolerância para desvios de segurança e qualidade.
  • Habilidade para negociar soluções técnicas complexas e gerenciar expectativas entre as disciplinas e o cliente.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com prazos apertados e em ambientes de projeto dinâmico, típicos da fase de detalhamento.

Desejável:

  • Registro ativo no CREA/CRQ.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado das especificações de grandes operadoras de O&G.
  • Experiência prévia em fase de FEED ou em Comissionamento/Partida de plantas.

title: BANCO DE TALENTOS - TECNICO DE RADIOLOGIA - HOSPITAL MUNICIPAL PEDRO II
description:
Job description

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Main responsibilities

Realizar exames por imagens, tais como: raio x, tomografia, ressonância magnética, radiologia digital e outros, de acordo com as normas, diretrizes e procedimentos técnicos e operacionais estabelecidos, a fim de prestar apoio diagnóstico para tratamento de diversas patologias.

Requirements and skills

Ensino Médio Completo

Curso Completo de Técnico de Radiologia

Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe

Experiência de 06 meses comprovada de experiência na função de Técnico em Radiologia.

Additional information

Local de trabalho: Santa Cruz - RJ

Escala de trabalho: 24 horas semanais

title: Linux Cryptography and Security Engineer
description:
Linux Cryptography and Security Engineer

2 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

This is a unique opportunity to use your software engineering and cryptography skills to build and maintain the security foundation that enables Ubuntu and its users to operate securely and remain compliant to international information security standards such as FIPS 140-3 and Common Criteria. You will use your applied cryptography, Linux Security, and coding skills to enhance the Ubuntu distribution and work with organizations such as DISA and CIS to draft and implement security hardening benchmarks for Ubuntu.

As a member of the Security Hardening team you will work with and develop automation tooling to audit deployed systems for DISA-STIG and CIS benchmark compliance. You will interact with internal and external stakeholders to identify gaps in our frameworks, and develop new solutions to address these challenges. In this role you will have the opportunity to influence team and security culture, facilitate technical delivery, and help drive team direction and execution. You'll collaborate closely with Canonical's kernel team as well as the wider engineering organization to drive features impacting all Ubuntu users.

Day-to-day responsibilities

  • Collaborate with other engineers in the Security Hardening team to achieve and retain various Security certifications
  • Extend and enhance Linux cryptographic components (OpenSSL, Libgcrypt, GnuTLS, and others) with the features and functionality required for FIPS and CC certification
  • Collaborate with external security consultants to test and validate kernel and crypto module components
  • Work with external partners to develop security hardening benchmarks and audit + remediation automation for Ubuntu
  • Contribute to Ubuntu mainline and upstream projects to land solutions and benefit the community
  • Communicate and collaborate within and outside Canonical to identify opportunities to improve our security posture, rapidly resolve issues, and deliver high-quality solutions on schedule

What we are looking for in you

  • Hands‑on experience with low‑level Linux cryptography APIs and debugging
  • Excellent software engineering fundamentals, including prior experience with C development, and the ability to demonstrate such
  • Hands‑on experience with Linux system administration and shell scripting
  • Demonstrated knowledge of security and cryptography fundamentals + direct experience writing secure code and implementing best practices
  • Significant development experience working with open source libraries
  • Excellent verbal and written communications to enable efficient collaboration with internal and external partners in a remote‑first environment

Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring

  • Prior experience working on FIPS/Common Criteria certified products and in‑depth knowledge of the underlying standards
  • Prior experience working directly with DISA‑STIG or CIS benchmarks, including related audit + remediation tooling (e.g. Compliance as Code)
  • Experience working directly with Linux Kernel
  • Prior experience with Python, OVAL (Open Vulnerability Assessment Language), and Ansible
  • History of contributions to open source projects

What we offer you

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence – in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

Canonical has been a remote‑first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st‑century digital business.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer. We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Aqui, energia não nos falta para buscar os melhores resultados, sempre com a segurança em primeiro lugar.   • Executar parecer técnico de fornecedores de equipamentos e instrumentos;
  • Realizar/verificar simulações de garantia de fluxo/escoamento;

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Engenharia Química, Engenharia de Produção, Engenharia de Processos ou correlatas.

  • CREA - Conselho Regional de Engenharia e Agronomia.
  • Domínio em Softwares de simulação (Hysys, Pipesim, Olga, AutoCAD)
  • Inglês avançado.

  • Experiência em softwares de simulação.
  • Experiência em projetos.
  • Habilidade em análise de dados e interpretação de simulação.
  • Familiaridade com normas de qualidade e regulamentações da indústria.
  • Capacidade de analisar problemas complexos e encontrar soluções eficazes.
  • Habilidade para comunicar informações técnicas e recomendações de forma clara e eficaz a diferentes públicos.
  • Capacidade de colaborar efetivamente com equipes multifuncionais.
  • Capacidade de se adaptar a mudanças e enfrentar desafios de forma proativa.
  • Capacidade de identificar problemas rapidamente e encontrar soluções eficazes.
  • Habilidade para gerenciar múltiplas tarefas e projetos simultaneamente com eficiência.
  • Sólida experiência com a coordenação da elaboração e monitoramento de cronogramas.
  • Habilidade avançada e comprovada na liderança de equipe e gestão de projetos.
  • Responsabilidade, comprometimento e acompanhamento com as metas estabelecidas.
  • Capacidade de avaliar desempenho, fornecer feedback construtivo promovendo o desenvolvimento profissional de toda equipe.

Administrativo – de segunda a sexta-feira, das 9h às 18h.

Com isso, participamos ativamente da expansão e da transformação da matriz de energia brasileira rumo à economia de baixo carbono.

description:
Job description

A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

A Concessionária

A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizou o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipais, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

Main responsibilities

  • Realizar a conferência e validação de informações financeiras, incluindo notas fiscais, medições e registros consolidados no sistema.
  • Apoiar nas análises de contratos, controles internos e conciliações.
  • Elaborar ofícios, organizar documentos para assinatura e apoiar no preenchimento de formulários e demais rotinas administrativas da área.
  • Validar dados das notas fiscais em alinhamento com a base do sistema, garantindo conformidade e precisão das informações.
  • Auxiliar na consolidação de bases, atualização de controles e preparação de relatórios e indicadores.
  • Contribuir para a padronização e melhoria contínua dos processos operacionais e financeiros.

Requirements and skills

  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Contabilidade, Economia, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia em atividades envolvendo conferência de documentos, contratos, medições ou rotinas correlatas.
  • Conhecimento de Excel intermediário.
  • Conhecimento em Power BI será considerado diferencial.
  • Perfil analítico, organizado, atento a detalhes e com boa gestão de prazos.
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de interação com diferentes áreas.

Additional information

  • Seguro de vida
  • Vale transporte
  • Vale alimentação e/ou refeição
  • Zenklub - atendimento direcionado à saúde mental

  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados

title: Analista de Sistemas Sênior
description:
Resumo da Vaga

Atuação em todo o ciclo de desenvolvimento de sistemas: levanta e define requisitos, programa, testa e implementa soluções. Identifica problemas técnicos e orienta na resolução, além de coordenar atividades de correção e manutenção. Codifica, realiza testes, elabora documentação e manuais de operação. Implementa novos sistemas e mantém os já existentes, ajustando-os conforme necessidades e mudanças dos usuários.

Principais Desafios e Responsabilidades da Função

  • Desenvolver e revisar a arquitetura de software, garantindo que seja escalável, flexível e atenda aos requisitos do negócio;
  • Fornecer liderança técnica para a equipe de desenvolvimento, orientando os membros juniores e intermediários, compartilhando conhecimentos;
  • Realizar revisões de código detalhadas para garantir a conformidade com os padrões de qualidade, segurança e boas práticas de codificação;

  • Pacote Office avançado;
  • Vivência na linguagem de desenvolvimento de React.js;
  • Especialista em Node.js com framework nest.js.
  • Conhecimento em Azure DEVOPS (versionamento de código) ou GIT.

  • Jornada/Escala: 5x2, 44h semanais;
  • Horário/Modalidade: Segunda à sexta;

title: OPERADOR DE CALDEIRA E UTILIDADES / Boiler & Utility Operator
description:
OPERADOR DE CALDEIRA E UTILIDADES / Boiler & Utility Operator

Published on DECEMBER 02, 2025

Applications open until JANUARY 31, 2026

Responsibilities and assignments

  • CBSP, Huete NR13

We are looking for professional to work as Boiler and Utility Operator in an Offshore opportunity.

To develop activities such as:

  • To assist, operate and maintain all machinery / auxiliary machinery connected with the operations of the Engine Room systems as requested by Engine room supervisor. Report to Engine Room Supervisor in case of any abnormality encountered during the task routine.
  • Operate the Steam system in a safe and efficient manner;
  • To be in compliance with all training defined by Modec and qualification requested
  • Regularly shall inspect and maintain all equipment of the Steam system in good condition of operation to guarantee the efficiency and safety;
  • To register any anomaly in the log book and safety book as requested by NR 13 to all equipment classified as NR 13 that shall be in compliance with the rules defined in its safety book. As well as to inform the equipment inspector about that;
  • To keep all data control updated and controlled;
  • To keep your workstation safety, clean and organized;
  • Ensure that all of equipment used, workshops, work areas, are always maintained in a clean and tidy condition, including chemical and paint areas;
  • To carry out chipping and painting as required.
  • To check and record water tanks, fuel oil and other tanks ullages and quantity as defined by the Maintenance Superintendent or when requested;
  • Assist during internal transfer of fuel oil.
  • Assist during tanks bunkering operations and ensure they are conducted in accordance with rules and regulations.
  • Perform the water analysis and chemicals adjust requested to keep quality of operation;
  • Assist in all operations of the ship’s boilers and equipment associates, when applicable;
  • To guarantee boiler operation is always assisted and monitored during its operation, when applicable. As well as to know where are all documentation and the operation manual;
  • Inspect the existing system for leaks, corrosion as well as advise the engine room supervisor about any irregularities found;
  • Attend safety meetings when required, and to participate in the investigation of accidents and incidents;
  • Ensure that the system of permission to work (PTW) is available and approved by all responsible. As well as all recommendations are implemented, as example: All areas are isolates in conformity with the isolation procedures of MODEC;
  • Carry out any additional tasks inside your professional competence when requested by the Engine room supervisor or head of crew;
  • Ensure that maintenance work is carried out in a safe and responsible manner, and in compliance with requirements and provisions of safety and corporate management system;
  • Safeguarding the welfare of yourself and fellow crewmembers;
  • Ensure that all activity is being carried out inside of MODEC HSEQ policies, as : The emergency response duties, theModec HSEQ Policy , MODEC Management System Rules and Responsibilities are clearly understood.

Requirements

  • Tecnical Degree and/or Oiler
  • Previous experience as Utility Operator
  • BST, Huet and NR13

Additional information

Being part of MODEC means being the PROTAGONIST of a CHALLENGING career and being in touch with the latest deep-water production systems, knowing that your career begins in BRAZIL, but your talent can take you anywhere in the WORLD.

- If you want to be one of the greatest in the market, this is your opportunity!!

- As a MULTICULTURAL company that respects DIVERSITY, we encourage PWD application in our process.

Process stages

  • Step 1: Registration 1 Registration
  • Step 2: Entrevista RH / HR Interview 2 Entrevista RH / HR Interview
  • Step 3: PEP 3 PEP
  • Step 6: ASO 6 ASO
  • Step 9: Hiring 9 Hiring

Career without borders

If you are dynamic, committed , have an innovative spirit and want to work in a multinational company that is a reference in the oil and gas industry, embark on this journey with us.

We are MODEC, the largest independent operator of FPSO platforms in the world and we want to go further to offer the best technology and the best solutions for our customers and the market. Therefore, we invest in professionals who enjoy challenges and want to grow in a solid, ethical and multicultural company .

Working at MODEC means being in a global environment . Your career may start in Brazil, but your talent can take you around the world and open up new professional frontiers . We have over 50 years of experience in the oil and gas industry operating on five continents. We are very proud to have been in Brazil for 20 years and support the growth of the oil and gas sector.

description:
Job description

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Main responsibilities

Planejar, implementar e monitorar a distribuição de medicamentos, produtos e materiais nas diversas unidades do hospital, orientando sobre dados técnicos, tais como: dosagem, fórmula farmacêutica, composição química, substitutos etc; produzir; executar a guardar e controlar a distribuição de medicamentos; realizar controle diário dos estoques.

Requirements and skills

Ensino Superior Completo em Farmácia.

Especialização completa em uma ou mais das áreas citadas a seguir: Farmácia Clínica, Atenção Farmacêutica ou Residência Multiprofissional em Saúde. Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe.

Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada na função de Farmacêutico na área da saúde.

Additional information

Local: Santa Cruz - RJ

Escala: 12H trabalhadas x 60H de descanso

Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

A Concessionária

A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizou o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipais, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com apromoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

title: Analista Financeiro Júnior
description:
#VemSerMAG

Se você quer trabalhar com propósito, desenvolver sua carreira, mas sem deixar de lado sua saúde e bem-estar, a MAG é o seu lugar Temos em nosso DNA a inovação e o cuidado com as pessoas. Desde 2016 estamos na lista das melhores empresas para se trabalhar, segundo a Great Place to Work.

Somos uma empresa PLURAL

Diversidade e inclusão estão na pauta constante da MAG. Nos orgulhamos de ser uma companhia formada por mais de 80% de todos os nossos colaboradores pertencentes a, pelo menos, um grupo minorizado. Contamos também com o Plural, programa formal, estruturado e direcionado ao fomento da diversidade e inclusão.

Nosso propósito e valores

Estamos em busca de pessoas que tenham valores alinhados aos nossos: Atitude de dono, História de transformação, Relações duradouras e Ser presente.

Na MAG temos o forte propósito de oferecer soluções financeiras nos diversos momentos de vida de todos os brasileiros . Nos últimos três anos, realizamos o pagamento de mais de R$ 1 bilhão em benefícios a milhares de famílias. Dados como esse que nos levam a ser referência no mercado de Vida e Previdência, com quase 200 anos de atuação ininterrupta no Brasil.

Somos parte do Grupo Aegon, um dos maiores grupos de Seguro de Vida e Previdência do mundo. No Brasil, nossa força também impressiona: temos mais de 5,8 milhões de vidas seguradas e crescemos, em média, 16% ao ano na última década.

Quer fazer parte dessa história? Conheça a nossa oportunidade.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Executar rotinas de backoffice e tesouraria, incluindo controle de fluxo de caixa, pagamentos e recebimentos.

  • Conhecimento em cabines SPB e SPI (mesmo que em nível de apoio ou supervisão).
  • Vivência com conciliação financeira e controle de operações.
  • Conhecimento em investimentos e crédito será considerado diferencial.
  • Disponibilidade para atuação híbrida, presencialmente de 4 a 8 vezes por mês no Centro do Rio de Janeiro. Caso seja colaborador(a) da MAG e resida fora do Rio, a atuação deverá ocorrer em unidade da MAG mais próxima à residência, na mesma frequência.

Há mais de 190 anos temos como propósito prover soluções financeiras individuais nos diversos momentos de vida de todos os brasileiros.

Para isso, contamos com a dedicação de mais de 1.500 colaboradores em todo o país, que vestem a camisa deste time e nos fazem ser uma das melhores companhias para trabalhar no Brasil.

A cultura MAG é formada por nossos valores corporativos, que são reflexo do comportamento que manifestamos, de quem somos e muito nos orgulhamos:
